titulo: Mobile, weight, and "reduced motion": the site that opens fast
lead: Many people open the page on a phone held upright, on a mobile network, and some have asked their system for less motion. A horizontal film cropped to a vertical screen loses its subject; a film that moves by force bothers people who asked it to stop. You check the page on a 390 px phone, with reduced motion on, and cut the weight of the vertical film.
objetivo: check on a 390 px phone, with reduced motion on and on the first load, that the page opens fast and does not force motion.

aprende.t: Vertical film (frames-v/) and fit by crop fraction, instead of always covering
prefers-reduced-motion and the Parado / Ligado / Raio-X (Still / On / X-ray) switch
Cut the weight on mobile without dropping frames
What belongs to this course and what belongs to the ARCKHÉSEO Formation

hero_alt: Phone held upright on a stand showing a vertical misty landscape, next to a laptop with a chart.

nos.detalhe: HTML, CSS, JS, and frame 1. The stage background already shows frame 1 through CSS while the canvas hasn't drawn yet: the screen is never black while it waits.

A phone held upright (up to 719 px, portrait) calls for the vertical film. A 16:9 covering 390×844 keeps only the center of each frame: most of the composition disappears at the sides (scroll-film-studio, references/engine.md).

The engine covers the screen while the crop is small and fits the whole frame when it would pass the limit (22% on desktop). With the vertical film on the phone, the crop is small and the kit allows up to 80%.

With prefers-reduced-motion, the kit's page stops the film: it becomes a photo, the text sits still below, and the 400vh track goes away. The Parado / Ligado / Raio-X (Still / On / X-ray) switch lets anyone choose; the M key toggles it.
verificar.mjs with --celular opens at 390×844 and requires frames-v; with --reduzir it requires the same frame at 0%, 50%, and 100%.

secoes.legenda: Speed measured on a real network, Core Web Vitals, and PageSpeed belong to the ARCKHÉSEO course. Here: the weight of the film and the motion.

secoes.sub: The checker's two modes on the kit's page.

blocos.rot: Terminal · check on the phone and with reduced motion
blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/formacao-cARCKHÉ-ia-sites-v72/kit
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-sites/a7; rm -rf "$E"; mkdir -p "$E"
node "$K/scripts/servir.mjs" "$K/site" > "$E/url.txt" & S=$!
until U=$(cat "$E/url.txt") && [ -n "$U" ] && curl -s -o /dev/null "$U"; do sleep 0.3; done
node "$K/scripts/verificar.mjs" "$U" --celular; echo "saída: $?"
node "$K/scripts/verificar.mjs" "$U" --reduzir | tail -2; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
kill $S

secoes.titulo: The phone weighed more than the desktop
secoes.sub: In lesson 1, the phone downloaded 3.52 MB and the desktop 1.54 MB. Redoing only the vertical film at 600 px and -q:v 8 fixes it, without dropping frames.

blocos.rot: Terminal · redo the vertical film lighter
blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/formacao-cARCKHÉ-ia-sites-v72/kit
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-sites/a7; rm -rf "$E/site"; cp -r "$K/site" "$E/site"
python3 "$K/scripts/peso.py" "$E/site" --orcamento 3 | grep -E "^celular|orçamento"
# the vertical film again: 600 px wide and JPEG -q:v 8 (was 720 px and 6)
bash "$K/scripts/clipe.sh" "$K/exemplos/lente.jpg" "$E/v.mp4" 6 1.0 1.35 1080x1920
bash "$K/scripts/quadros.sh" "$E/v.mp4" "$E/site/frames-v" 600 8
python3 "$K/scripts/peso.py" "$E/site" --orcamento 3 --inicial 0.5 | grep -E "^celular|orçamento|teto"; echo "saída: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

secoes.sub: From the two skills and from what the checker measures.

texto: A phone held upright gets a vertical film: a 9:16 clip from the generator or, in the rehearsal, clipe.sh with 1080x1920.
Without frames-v/, the kit falls back to the horizontal one covering the screen.
Measure the phone separately (peso.py already does) and give it the tightest budget.
Cut width and -q:v before pulling frames.
Reduced motion on = still film and readable text, with no locked scroll.
The on-screen switch leaves the choice to people who didn't change the system, too.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: A 16:9 film covering the screen of a phone held upright (390×844). What happens?
opcoes: It looks sharp, because the phone has a high pixel density.
It shows up whole, with black bars above and below, and nothing is cropped.
The browser switches to the vertical film on its own.
Only the center of each frame is left, and the subject can fall off the screen.
perguntas.explica: Covering a vertical screen with a wide frame crops the sides. That is why there is the vertical film (frames-v/) and the fit by crop fraction.

perguntas.p: The person turned on "reduce motion" in their system. What does the kit's page do?
opcoes: It shows the film at a slower speed.
It stops the film on a still photo and leaves the text still below it.
Nothing: scrolling is an action by the person, not an animation the site triggers.
perguntas.explica: A scroll-bound film is motion triggered by the person, and anyone who asked for less motion gets the still version. The checker compares the same frame at 0%, 50% and 100%.

perguntas.p: The phone is 1.2 MB over budget. What is the first adjustment?
opcoes: Redo the vertical film with a smaller width or a higher -q:v.
Remove half of the frames from the vertical one.
Use the horizontal film on the phone too.
Swap the frames for an autoplay video, which the browser compresses better.
perguntas.explica: Width and -q:v take off weight without turning it into a slideshow. In the rehearsal: 720 px and -q:v 6 = 3.52 MB; 600 px and -q:v 8 = 2.28 MB, the same 144 frames.

perguntas.p: Where do I learn to measure Core Web Vitals and site speed for search?
perguntas.explica: This course measures the weight of the film and the motion. Performance for search has an owner: the Formação ARCKHÉSEO.

itens.texto: A phone held upright gets frames-v/ and a fit by crop fraction.
Still film, readable text, key on the screen.
Phone measured separately; width and -q:v before removing frames.
